_doc: Bootstrap config for scripts/extract-figma-vars.js. Commit this file. Do NOT commit figma-variables.json (it is gitignored and regenerated by npm run tokens:refresh).

aliasValidation._doc: Warn during extraction if the live Alias collection has fewer than minVarCount variables (excluding properties/* entries). The current snapshot has 188. Set lower than 188 to allow a partially rebuilt collection without blocking extraction.

themes._doc: Theme collection IDs and slugs. collectionId is the Figma API collection ID. slug is the data-theme CSS attribute value. If a collection is recreated in Figma (new ID, same name), update collectionId here. The extractor also matches by name as a fallback and warns when an ID mismatch is detected.

nonThemeCollections._doc: Maps Figma collection display names to the JSON key used in figma-variables.json output. If Figma renames a collection, update the left side only. If the output key needs to change, update the right side (and also update generate-css-tokens.js which reads data[key]).
